description: Providers similar to a given one (alternatives) by shared tags, areas, industry, region, and artifact coverage. Products under the same owner (a sister, not a rival) are left out of the ranking and listed in meta.query.family; include_family=true ranks them in, flagged same_estate.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

include_family.description: Rank same-owner products in with the rivals (flagged same_estate) instead of listing them in meta.query.family.

slug.description: Provider slug — lowercase, hyphenated, as find_providers returns it, e.g. "stripe".

name: find_similar_providers
